data.name: LC_SOLVER_SETTINGS_MAX_BRED_IRRELEVANT_TRAITS_DESCRIPTION
data.value:
The maximum number of irrelevant passive skills allowed for any bred pal, including the final breeding result.
Values higher than '1' will typically add shorter breeding paths if there are unused passive skill slots in the final pal.
Higher values *exponentially* affect time required.

data.name: LC_SOLVER_SETTINGS_MAX_BREEDING_STEPS_DESCRIPTION
data.value:
The maximum number of breeding steps to reach the target pal.
(This value should typically be smaller than "Max Solver Steps".)
Higher values cause Pal Calc to consider more options, and linearly affects computation time.

data.name: LC_SOLVER_SETTINGS_MAX_CPU_DESCRIPTION
data.value: The number of CPUs the solver is allowed to use. If zero, all CPUs will be used.

data.name: LC_SOLVER_SETTINGS_MAX_INPUT_IRRELEVANT_TRAITS_DESCRIPTION
data.value:
The maximum number of irrelevant passive skills allowed for any owned pal used as a parent.
Lower values can somewhat reduce processing at risk of missing some useful paths.
Higher values linearly affect computation time.

data.name: LC_SOLVER_SETTINGS_MAX_SOLVER_STEPS_DESCRIPTION
data.value:
The maximum number of times the breeding solver will run. Larger values may allow Pal Calc to find more options when searching for the optimal breeding path.
(Pal Calc will detect if additional breeding attempts are needed and may stop before reaching this limit.)
(This value should typically be the same as, or bigger than, "Max Breeding Steps".)
Higher values linearly affect computation time.

data.name: LC_SOLVER_SETTINGS_MAX_WILD_PALS_DESCRIPTION
data.value: The maximum number of wild pals to allow in a breeding path. Higher values linearly affect time required, depending on how many types of pals are owned.

data.name: LC_SOLVER_SETTINGS_USE_GENDER_REVERSERS_DESCRIPTION
data.value:
Whether to assume the use of Gender Reversers for breeding effort calculations. This prevents Pal Calc from including gender probabilities, and allows Pal Calc to force-breed pals with incompatible genders.
Gender Reversers are not shown in the breeding graph. If enabled, Owned Pals in the graph may be shown with a different gender.

data.name: LC_SOLVER_SETTINGS_MAX_GOLD_COST_DESCRIPTION
data.value:
The maximum total gold cost for breeding paths which use the Surgery Table to add or replace passives.
Set this to 0 to prevent using the Surgery Table for passive skills.
Higher values have minimal effect on time required.

data.name: LC_LOCATION_MANUAL_SAVES_INSTRUCTIONS
data.value:
Save files shared manually can be added here. A Palworld save is a folder containing:
1. A Level.sav file - This is the main save data. 2. A LevelMeta.sav file - This contains info like the host's player name and in-game day. 3. A Player folder containing one or more .sav files - This identifies each player and the Pal Containers they own.
Level.sav is required. Pal Calc benefits from the other files but can operate without them.
When playing a P2P multiplayer session ("Multiplayer" set to "On"), the host can use Pal Calc to export the save files to a ZIP and share with others.
When playing on a dedicated server, these files must be gathered manually. You may need to ask the server host for a copy. Save files are typically included in any "backups" of server data.

data.name: LC_LOCATION_FAKE_SAVES_INSTRUCTIONS
data.value:
A "Virtual Save" is a placeholder for players who are otherwise unable to load their save file into Pal Calc. (e.g. PlayStation saves, or Server saves where the server host does not provide a copy of the save files.)
Like all other save types, you can use the Save Inspector window ("Selected Save" menu → "Inspect") to manually add pals for the solver to use. The "Pal Containers" section on the left has a "Custom Containers" option where you can add and edit pals.

data.name: LC_LOCATION_STEAM_INSTRUCTIONS
data.value:
Pal Calc automatically detects standard save files managed by Steam. A Steam location appears in Pal Calc for each user with Palworld save data.
When connecting to another person's multiplayer world, Palworld does not download the full save file. The data must be manually collected and added to "Local Files". See that section for more details.

data.name: LC_LOCATION_XBOX_INSTRUCTIONS
data.value:
Pal Calc automatically detects standard save files managed by Xbox Game Pass. An Xbox location appears in Pal Calc for each user with Palworld save data.
When connecting to another person's multiplayer world, Palworld does not download the full save file. The data must be manually collected and added to "Local Files". See that section for more details.
